frontmatter.title: Understanding the HTML Base Tag and Resolving Conflicts with Anchor Links
frontmatter.subheading: How the HTML Base Tag Can Affect Anchor Tags and How to Fix It
frontmatter.excerpt: An in-depth look at how the HTML `<base>` tag can conflict with anchor tags having `href=#`. Learn how to resolve these conflicts for better webpage navigation.
